violation_type.title: Policies for Release of Children - Record Identity of Person (26 TAC §744.2803(b))
violation_type.short_title: Policies for Release of Children - Record Identity of Person
violation_type.typical_finding: A child was observed being released to someone who had not been identified by the operation. The operation failed to record the identity by a valid photo ID, or  license plate. The staff stood at the door during the release.

finding_variants.text: A child was observed being released to someone who had not been identified by the operation. The operation failed to record the identity by a valid photo ID, or  license plate. The staff stood at the door during the release.
There has been an unauthorized person unknown to staff who attempted to pickup a child in care.
